version.approval_notes: Unofficial redesign of wiki-masters.com. Not minified: the build is readable as shipped; build with `bun run build` (repository below). Runs as a MAIN-world content script on wiki-masters.com only (Firefox 128+): it reads the page's own fetch responses and the game's Turnstile widget. No permissions, no data collected, no remote code.

summary.fr: Une nouvelle interface pour wiki-masters.com : paquets, collection, marché et échanges, sur les données du jeu. Non officiel.
summary.en-US: Unofficial redesign of wiki-masters.com: packs, collection, market and trades, on the game's own data.

description.fr: Non officiel, sans lien avec WikiMasters. Refait les paquets, la collection, le catalogue, le marché et les échanges ; les autres pages restent celles du site. Utilise votre propre session : aucun serveur, aucun suivi. Code source : https://github.com/KazeTachinuu/wiki-remaster
description.en-US: Unofficial, not affiliated with WikiMasters. Rebuilds packs, collection, catalogue, market and trades; every other page stays the original site. Uses your own session; no server, no tracking. Source: https://github.com/KazeTachinuu/wiki-remaster
